However, the ocean water is extremely cold, and anyone who goes into the water would certainly freeze to death. If I remove the barrier that is protecting 10 lifeboat passengers from falling overboard, the lifeboat will remain afloat and those remaining aboard will survive. If I do not do this, the lifeboat will sink and all of its passengers will freeze to death in the water.
